title: Emails and Correspondence
summary: This section summarizes the significant emails and communication leading up to the execution of the guarantee and their relevance to the case.
content: 22 Mr Cherry and Mr Sharpe sought to tender twenty pages of correspondence leading up to the entry into the Second Variation and the Guarantee as relevant to the construction of those documents. Grounds 3 and 4 of the appeal challenged the rejection of this aspect of the tender, and so it is necessary to summarise those documents, all of which were communications between two solicitors: Mr Andrew Kermode, acting on behalf of the purchaser and its directors, and Mr Michael Shillington, acting on behalf of the vendors.
